first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: A large expanse of teal seats arranged in stepped tiers, divided into sections by gray passageways, with light-colored side walls and railings visible in places.

entities.name: stadium roof and trusses
entities.identification: The canopy edge and light-colored beams partially visible along the upper edge of the opening image; the complete roof outline is cropped out.

entities.name: illuminated direction marker
entities.identification: A set of strip-shaped and angled illuminated markers near the route through the stands; in the final frame, the two bright foreground shapes are pink-purple and yellow-orange, respectively.
